## v1.12.0 — Major Module Expansion

Added 33 new modules across all categories, bringing ClaudeMC to feature parity with leading client mods.

### Combat
- **AutoCrystal** — Places and detonates end crystals on nearby players with damage estimation and anti-suicide check
- **Surround** — Places obsidian around your feet to protect against crystal explosions
- **TriggerBot** — Attacks automatically when your crosshair is on a valid target
- **Reach** — Extends melee attack and block interaction range
- **AntiBot** — Filters bot entities from combat targeting via tab-list and ping checks

### Movement
- **ElytraFlight** — Boost/Packet/Pitch-based elytra flight control
- **PacketFly** — Bypasses basic anti-fly via alternating ground-state packets
- **InventoryMove** — Allows WASD movement while any GUI is open
- **BunnyHop** — Auto-jumps on landing to maintain sprint momentum

### Render
- **HoleESP** — Highlights bedrock/obsidian-surrounded safe holes against crystals
- **OreESP** — X-ray ore scanner with tier filtering (Diamond+, Valuable, All)
- **Chams** — Renders entity hitboxes through walls with configurable alpha
- **Breadcrumbs** — Draws a path trail behind you to retrace your route
- **LogoutSpots** — Marks where players logged out during the session
- **Zoom** — Scrollable camera zoom (divides FOV)
- **Radar** — HUD minimap showing nearby players and mobs as coloured dots
- **TimeChanger** — Locks client-side time (Day/Night/Custom) — visual only
- **WeatherChanger** — Locks client-side weather (Clear/Rain/Thunder) — visual only
- **NoRender** — Suppresses totem pop, fire overlay, boss bar, scoreboard, potion HUD, particles

### Player
- **AutoFish** — Automatically reels in and recasts the fishing rod on bite detection
- **AutoFarm** — Harvests mature crops and replants seeds in a configurable radius
- **FastPlace** — Removes the 4-tick block placement cooldown
- **NoMiningFatigue** — Removes Mining Fatigue status effect client-side
- **InvManager** — Drops junk items from inventory automatically

### World
- **PacketMine** — Sends simultaneous start/stop break packets for instant mining attempts
- **AutoBuild** — Auto-places blocks in Floor, Bridge, or Column shapes

### Misc
- **AutoReply** — Automatically replies to AFK-check messages with human-like responses; configurable trigger/reply rules
- **AntiAFK** — Advanced staff detection: alerts on vanished players nearby, sudden player teleports into range, and incoming AFK-check messages; responds with natural look-around behaviour and notification
- **NameSpoof** — Overrides client-side display name (cosmetic)
- **ChatSpammer** — Sends a message or command on a configurable tick interval
- **PacketLogger** — Logs incoming chat/game packets to the mod logger for debugging
- **AntiSpam** — Filters duplicate and repetitive chat messages from the chat window
- **FakePlayer** — Spawns a client-side fake player entity at your position

### Infrastructure
- New mixins: `KeyboardInputMixin` (InventoryMove), `FastPlaceMixin` (FastPlace), `InGameHudMixin` (NoRender)
- `GameRendererMixin` extended with Zoom FOV override
- Radar integrated into HudManager overlay
